72zd:
The Pre-Masters in Business, Social Sciences and Humanities will introduce candidates to key elements related to their degree, such as analyzing business projects or interpreting statistics. This program leads to a number of masters degrees in the Faculties of Arts and Humanities and Social Sciences, including the Management School, School of Law and Sheffield School of Architecture at the University of Sheffield.

The Pre-Masters course is developed in collaboration with the University. Throughout this program students will develop the academic and English language skills needed for their chosen masters at Sheffield. Once they complete the Pre-Masters in Business, Social Sciences and Humanities and achieve the required grades, they can enter their chosen postgraduate degree at the University of Sheffield.
